OUR MISSION IS TO ENABLE EVERYONE TO BUILD WEALTH

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love.

Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success.

Today, we serve over 7 million clients, with more than €60 billion in assets under management - a testament to the scale and trust we’ve built in just a few years.

What you’ll do

- Take task ownership in quality aspect and be responsible for work estimates, execution and task closure initiatives

- Actively participate in design and requirements reviews to ensure testability and usability of features and products

- Design and develop manual and automated test cases to ensure the quality and reliability of our software products

- Plan, implement and execute testing tasks in different product areas - DB, integration, functional, UI/UX

- Analyse test results to identify areas for improvement and recommend process changes as needed

- Ensure that all testing activities are performed according to company standards

- Work in compact, autonomous teams with short release cycles - we rely on agile, independent teams of sharp and driven people with just the right amount of processes to steer off anarchy and not sacrifice velocity

WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE

- 2+ years of experience in software quality assurance, including experience with test automation

- Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies and best practices

- Good programming skills in at least one programming language (Python, TypeScript, Java, etc.)

- Advanced RDBMS knowledge

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- A very good command of English and excellent communication skills

- Passion about quality assurance

NICE TO HAVE

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, or a related field

- Experience with API testing tools such as Postman, SoapUI, or similar

- Experience with testing microservices and distributed systems

- Experience in testing mobile applications

- Familiarity with agile development methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban

WHAT WE OFFER

- Challenges that will help you grow and realise your potential really fast

- Opportunity to make a big Impact -you’ll be involved in developing cutting-edge services used by millions of investors to build wealth

- Work with smart, spirited, helpful, high-performing colleagues toward a common goal

- Appreciation for your talent and ideas

- Generous remuneration package including annual bonuses

- Excellent social benefits package, including private health insurance, sports card and 25 days of paid vacation per year

- Delicious treats and a spacious game room

Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker!

We thank all applicants, but only candidates selected for interview will be contacted. All personal data of applicants is protected by law and treated with strict confidentiality.
